description: Stage 5 calibration currently allows '--from-stage calibrate' to run and exit 0 on PRs whose execute failed, whose Stage 4 review never approved, or that have zero posted consensus reviews, logging 'Merged-head CI gate skipped: no Stage 4 approval recorded'.
goal: Enforce fail-closed prerequisites on Stage 5 entry in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stage5.py and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review_restart.py: refuse calibration with non-zero exit unless Stage 3 execute recorded status 'success' and Stage 4 review recorded status 'approved' with a posted GitHub consensus review (or a valid carried consensus fingerprint on a reviewed PR). Remove the silent 'Merged-head CI gate skipped: no Stage 4 approval recorded' pass-through so unreviewed or unexecuted flows can never exit Stage 5 successfully. Add unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_stage5_fail_closed.py proving unreviewed and failed-execute checkpoints are refused before any calibration commit. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Allowing Stage 5 calibrate to succeed on failed or unreviewed runs bypasses the consensus gate cleanly and lets unreviewed PRs appear calibrated.
acceptance_criteria: Stage 5 (`run_calibrate` / `stage5.py`) refuses calibration with non-zero exit unless `execute` succeeded and `review` reached consensus approval with a posted GitHub consensus review (or valid carried fingerprint on a reviewed PR).
Stage 5 removes the silent "Merged-head CI gate skipped: no Stage 4 approval recorded" pass-through so unreviewed or unexecuted runs cannot exit `0`.

Unit tests in `apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_stage5_fail_closed.py` fail without the guard and pass with `uv run pytest`, and `uv run task lint` passes cleanly; self-explaining code invariant holds.
